title: Terms of Sale & Warranty Policy
s1Body: These Terms of Sale govern the mutual rights, obligations, 24-month manufacturer warranty, and delivery terms between the Buyer (homeowner or B2B installer/contractor) and the Seller (UAB „Gilės inžinerija“).
s1Body2: All Danfoss, IMI Heimeier, IMI Pneumatex, IMI TA, and Ferroli products in our catalog are 100% genuine factory products with official manufacturer SKUs.
s3Body: All prices are displayed in Euros including 21% VAT (with ex-VAT prices shown for B2B buyers). An official VAT invoice is issued automatically for every order.
s3Body2: Accepted payment methods: online banking, Visa / Mastercard, or proforma invoice under an approved B2B project quote (RFQ).
s4: 4. Nationwide Delivery Across Lithuania (1–3 Business Days)
s4Body: Orders are delivered within 1–3 business days to your home, directly to your jobsite, or to an Omniva / DPD / LP Express parcel locker. Heavy boilers and large expansion vessels are shipped via secure pallet freight.
s4Body2: For detailed delivery tiers and dimensions, see our Shipping & Returns page.
s5Body: Unused components in original packaging can be returned within 14 calendar days hassle-free. If you ordered the wrong thread or diameter (e.g., DN15 instead of DN20, or Danfoss RA Click instead of M30×1.5), we exchange it for the compatible part.
